title: IRGC Fires 13 Ballistic Missiles at Camp Titin and Prince Hassan Air Base, Jordan — 10 Intercepted
detail: In retaliation for the September 1 US strikes, Iran's Revolutionary Guards launched a 'heavy' ballistic missile attack on Camp Titin — a US Marine training facility on Jordan's Red Sea coast near Aqaba — and on Prince Hassan Air Base on Wednesday, September 2. Jordan's Armed Forces intercepted 10 of the 13 incoming missiles; the remaining 3 fell in remote areas with no reported casualties or damage. Iran's army said it 'neutralized' US forces and destroyed facilities and attack helicopters at Camp Titin, a claim not corroborated by Jordanian or US officials.

title: IRGC Drones Target Ali Al Salem Air Base Commander's HQ in Kuwait; Kuwait Reports Interception, No Casualties
detail: Iran's army said it struck the headquarters and residence of the American commander at Ali Al Salem Air Base in Kuwait with drones on September 2, claiming it set fire to a drone hangar and a UAV launch ramp, destroyed several US drones, and killed an unspecified number of US soldiers. Kuwaiti authorities confirmed intercepting drones and missiles over its territory but reported no casualties or damage, directly disputing Iran's damage claims.

media.caption: Iran's multi-front retaliation against US-linked Gulf bases, Sept 2, 2026

confidenceReason: Iran claims a hangar fire, destroyed drones, and US soldiers killed at Ali Al Salem; Kuwait confirms only interception and reports no casualties or damage.

title: IRGC Suicide Drones Target Sheikh Isa Air Base Radar Sites in Bahrain; Shelter Alerts Issued
detail: Iran's army launched intensive suicide-drone attacks at dawn on September 2 against Sheikh Isa Air Base in Bahrain, targeting radar installations and assembly areas for US forces stationed there. Bahrain's Ministry of Interior issued repeated alerts instructing residents to take shelter. Iran described the attack as being in direct response to the US strikes that hit southern Iran and the Strait of Hormuz area the day before. Bahraini authorities have not confirmed damage or casualties.

confidenceReason: Single-pole (Iranian state/army) claim of a direct hit on Sheikh Isa radar sites; Bahrain has not confirmed damage or casualties.

title: IRGC Combined Missile-Drone Attack Hits US-Linked Facilities Near Erbil, Iraq
detail: As part of its September 2 multi-front retaliation for the prior day's US strikes, Iran's Revolutionary Guards launched a combined missile and drone attack against US-linked facilities near Erbil, Iraqi Kurdistan. Details on damage, interceptions, and casualties have not been independently confirmed by Iraqi Kurdish security or US officials.
